brief.t: START HERE: Call Polo 4PL now and confirm whether TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 was physically picked up before free time expires today.

ACT NOW 1: Polo container TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 had an October 9 pickup appointment, but physical pickup and release remain unconfirmed. Polo and dispatch are waiting on closure. The appointment was 3 calendar days ago, and the free-time extension expires today, October 12. Send: Vic, please confirm whether TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 was physically picked up; if not, send today's recovery appointment and confirm storage remains waived through release.

ACT NOW 2: FedEx could not deliver Jedwards shipment 384100536855 because the recipient was unavailable. The 8 lb shipment references MIXTOPH and PO W01276441, and FedEx says it will reattempt the next business day, today. Receiving is waiting on the material; the failed attempt is 1 calendar day old. Send: Please make sure someone can receive FedEx shipment 384100536855 today and confirm receipt of the MIXTOPH material and COA as soon as it arrives.

ACT NOW 3: TALOVA reported a lip balm stockout and requested 500 more units; delivery of the earlier 15,000 units remains unverified. Marcello is waiting. The request is about 3 calendar days old with no completion visible. Send: Marcello, we are checking availability and the ship date for the additional 500 and verifying delivery of the prior 15,000; I will confirm both today.

next: Recommendation: Close Polo first because free time expires today, then secure the FedEx redelivery before resolving TALOVA.
Estogel was displaced from Act Now by the failed FedEx delivery because the material is already at the final receiving step and redelivery is due today.
Scheduled: 6 email-derived milestones. The nearest is FedEx shipment 384100536855, due for reattempt today.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions are signed out. Purchasing has no current source records to verify open supplier, QC, inventory, or lead-time risks. The Email lane was connected and the request routed, but no fresh reply was captured during this run. Missing data is not zero.
signal: Polo pickup remains unconfirmed on the free-time deadline. FedEx missed delivery of MIXTOPH material and plans to reattempt today. TALOVA's stockout and 500-unit replenishment remain unresolved.
redflags: Polo physical pickup is unverified and free time expires today, October 12.
FedEx shipment 384100536855 containing MIXTOPH material was not delivered and is due for reattempt today.
TALOVA's requested 500-unit replenishment and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 units remain unverified.
CRM and WhatsApp could not be scanned because both browser sessions are signed out.
noise: 9 inbound Outlook messages arrived during the exact review window; 7 were noise and 2 carried actionable purchasing or receiving information.
